english.title: Permit use of a long vehicle with no side marker lamps fitted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a time between

(A)_[sunset and sunrise]_
(B)_[sunrise and sunset when visibility was seriously reduced]_

(C)_[a long vehicle,]_
(D)_[a combination of vehicles,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the

(E)_[vehicle]_
(F)_[combination of vehicles]_

was not fitted with the obligatory side marker lamps as specified in column 3 of the table to regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) at a time between

(A)_[sunset and sunrise]_
(B)_[sunrise and sunset when visibility was seriously reduced]_

**(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), being a long vehicle or combination of vehicles, which was not fitted with the requisite number of obligatory side marker lamps.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
